text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened in front of the school gates—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Curren!
If it's okay, could we take a photo toge—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Yaaay♪ All set!
I just came up with the cutest pose ever~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you came up with a pose just for me...!?
Amazing! You're so cute, Curren Chan!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll treasure this photo for the rest of my life!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...That was close, so close.
No good, Curren. You can't let your guard down, nuh-uh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps due to running in consecutive races lately,
Curren Chan seems to be feeling fatigued.
It might be best to review her schedule.
